requirements: R1: Repair the database initialization so that the application starts successfully without failing on the missing 'strains' relation during migrations.

slices.title: Repair flyway migration ordering for strains table
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want the flyway migrations to execute in the correct order, so that the database initializes without error.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh database
When the application runs Flyway migrations
Then all migrations complete successfully
Given the migrations complete
When the application health check is queried
Then it returns a healthy status.
